description:
Global HR | HR Strategy | Continuous Improvement | Employee Lifecycle | Project Management | Change & Transformation

Join Avanto - A Leader in the Furniture Industry!

About Avanto:

Avanto is an innovative and forward-thinking company transforming the furniture industry through technology and a people-centric approach. We stand out for our cutting-edge solutions, exceptional service, and strong commitment to excellence, integrity, and innovation.

At Avanto, we foster an environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally, promoting collaboration, continuous learning, and a results-driven culture. Our mission is to make a positive impact on the industry by driving change and continuous improvement.

About the Tech Lead / Architect

This role focuses on defining and evolving our sophisticated microservices architecture, establishing architectural patterns, and leading technical initiatives across frontend, backend, and infrastructure teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, evolve, and govern a scalable microservices architecture , including service boundaries and integration patterns.
  • Define and enforce architectural standards , coding guidelines, and best practices across engineering teams.
  • Evaluate, select, and standardize technologies, frameworks, and tooling aligned with long-term platform strategy.
  • Create reusable architectural patterns , reference implementations, and clearly defined golden paths .
  • Produce and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation , including ADRs, system diagrams, and technical specifications.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner with frontend, backend, and DevOps teams to ensure architectural alignment and consistency.
  • Participate in architectural and design reviews, providing guidance on complex technical decisions.
  • Mentor senior engineers and serve as a technical leader across the organization.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, and internal knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap , platform evolution strategy, and technology adoption decisions.
  • Design platform-wide performance optimization strategies , including caching, scalability patterns, and resource efficiency.
  • Define security architecture baselines , covering authentication, authorization, and data protection.
  • Architect end-to-end observability solutions , including metrics, logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing.
  • Identify, prioritize, and drive remediation of technical debt across the platform.
  • Proactively identify architectural risks and design mitigation strategies to ensure system reliability and resilience.
  • Design and enforce tenant isolation , data security, and boundary enforcement mechanisms.
  • Define tenant-aware routing, schema management, and data access patterns.
  • Architect tenant validation frameworks, authorization checks, and security controls.
  • Ensure scalable resource allocation and performance optimization in a multi-tenant environment.
  • Define service boundaries, domain models, and inter-service communication patterns.
  • Design and govern RESTful and GraphQL APIs , including versioning and integration strategies.
  • Architect event-driven systems , including message queues and asynchronous processing.
  • Define service mesh patterns such as service discovery, load balancing, and circuit breakers.
  • Design AWS cloud architecture, including multi-account strategies and cost optimization.
  • Define Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform, including secure state management.
  • Architect containerization and orchestration strategies.
  • Design secure and scalable CI/CD pipelines , deployment strategies, and environment promotion models.

Observability Architecture

  • Design distributed tracing solutions using OpenTelemetry and Jaeger.
  • Define metrics, dashboards, and alerting strategies using Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Establish structured logging, log aggregation, and analysis standards.
  • Define SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets across services.

Critical Architectural Challenges to Address

  • Security : JWT validation, tenant isolation, rate limiting, input validation, credential management.
  • Performance : Connection pooling, caching strategies, query optimization, frontend performance budgets.
  • Observability : End-to-end tracing, correlation IDs, metrics completeness, alerting maturity.
  • Multi-Tenancy : Prevent cross-tenant access and enforce strong validation mechanisms.

You will lead the architectural design and execution of solutions addressing these challenges.

Service-Specific Architecture Ownership

  • API Gateway : Routing, security, performance, and observability patterns.
  • Identity Service : OAuth2, JWT, RBAC, multi-tenant authentication and authorization.
  • GraphQL Services : Schema design, resolver optimization, query performance, and security controls.
  • RFQ & Workflow Services : Event-driven procurement workflows and integrations.
  • Data Upload Services : Streaming, memory optimization, scalability, and security controls.
  • AI Services : Secure and scalable AI integrations, async processing, tenant isolation, and performance optimization.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Architecture Expertise (Must Have)

  • Microservices Architecture : Design and evolution of distributed systems; service (text incomplete).
  • Multi-Tenancy Patterns : Schema-per-tenant architecture, tenant isolation, data security, tenant-aware routing, infrastructure as code strategies.
  • Large-Scale Systems : 100,000+ lines of code, complex business logic, enterprise patterns.
  • Distributed Systems : Service mesh, service discovery, distributed tracing, circuit breakers.
  • Performance Engineering : Query optimization, caching strategies, load balancing, scalability patterns.
  • Security Architecture : OAuth2/JWT, RBAC, data encryption, audit logging, security baselines.
  • Observability : Distributed tracing, metrics, logging, SLOs, error budgets.

title: Attending Veterinarian | Paulínia (SP)
description:
Zoetis values and supports inclusion, and is committed to equal opportunities.

Position Summary

Responsible for upholding the highest standards of ethical care and welfare for research subjects at the Zoetis Research Center in Paulínia, ensuring full compliance with all company policies as well as relevant local and international regulations and legislation concerning research practices. Additional responsibilities include supporting in vivo studies, training colleagues, and providing backup in related procedures. The role also involves establishing and monitoring key welfare and care metrics across the research operations.

Responsibilities

  • In collaboration with area management, develop and maintain a high-quality care program to promote health, wellbeing, and regulatory compliance for research activities at the Paulínia site. Focus areas include: disease prevention, biosafety, sanitation, pest control, management practices, safe handling protocols, responsible medication use and storage, and humane endpoints.
  • Perform daily rounds throughout the site to conduct veterinary inspections, ensuring optimal welfare conditions and that teams adhere to established procedures.
  • Maintain comprehensive records for research subjects to ensure traceability and documentation of medical history.
  • Guarantee ready access to controlled and non-controlled medications for research needs.
  • In collaboration with CEUA, expand and apply knowledge regarding local regulations and Zoetis internal standards to support accreditation and sustain best practice requirements.
  • Ensure complete alignment with Zoetis policies and the laws and guidelines of relevant authorities such as CONCEA, MAPA, CRMV, and others.
  • Actively participate in committee meetings and protocol reviews, sharing relevant updates and decisions with site teams in partnership with area leadership.
  • Report and communicate any events or concerns related to research subjects according to internal protocols and external regulations, updating the global team and implementing preventive measures as needed.
  • Provide technical expertise in veterinary science to support Zoetis and VMRD objectives, meeting client needs and contributing to collaborative scientific and service outcomes.
  • Apply scientific principles and practices to the development of tools and technologies that advance research models for drug discovery and development.
  • Collaborate with project teams to support research initiatives, including protocol and model development.
  • Foster communication between VMRD and GMS, serving as a role model for the broader Zoetis organization and presenting results internally and externally.
  • Train, educate, and guide colleagues in best practices regarding clinical procedures, research handling, care, and experiment-related workflows.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, emphasizing the principles of the 3Rs wherever possible.
  • Serve as the representative of the Paulínia site on the Zoetis Global Animal Welfare Committee.
  • As part of contingency planning, support in vivo research activities when needed.
  • Proactively prevent unsafe practices by following established safety guidelines and ensuring proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Medicine, with an active CRMV license for at least 5 years.
  • Previous technical experience with the facility's working species – poultry and rodents – is desirable.
  • Solid experience in animal facilities or in the animal health products industry is preferred.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • A master's or PhD degree is desirable to provide additional technical support to the research team.
  • Planning and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team.
  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) principles.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to ensure positive relationships with colleagues from other departments.
  • In-depth knowledge of animal welfare and relevant regulations.
  • Activities are primarily concentrated at the animal facility located in Paulínia.
  • Work is preferably performed while standing, and requires moving between multiple buildings within the facility. Access to each building that houses different species must be performed according to established standard procedures, including changing clothes, showering, and other relevant protocols.
  • The employee must be willing to work weekends and outside of regular hours as required, according to on‑call schedules and veterinary occurrences.
  • The collaborator must also be available for activities outside the Paulínia site, such as meetings at Zoetis units in Campinas and/or São Paulo, visits to service providers and suppliers, as well as participation in events related to the field.

About Zoetis

At Zoetis, our purpose is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. As a Fortune 500 company and the world leader in animal health, we discover, develop, manufacture and commercialize vaccines, medicines, diagnostics and other technologies for companion animals and livestock. We know our people drive our success. Our award‑winning culture, built around our Core Beliefs, focuses on our colleagues' careers, connection and support. We offer competitive healthcare and retirement savings benefits, along with an array of benefits, policies and programs to support employee well‑being in every sense, from health and financial wellness to family and lifestyle resources.

We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets.   • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining voice interconnects, SIP/RTP based
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Knowledge about VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing
  • IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes including P/S/I-CSCF, Application Servers
  • IMS Protocol Interfaces – GM Interface, ISC interface, Sh Interface, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc.
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online). Knowledge and experience of OCS and, Ro, Ro+, Ga and Bp interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocol
  • Knowledge and experience with Signaling Gateways and protocols including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP and CAMEL
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

description:
Visão geral

A Unico é a maior rede de verificação de identidade do mundo e um pilar de confiança na sociedade digital. Com soluções baseadas em biometria facial, machine learning e camadas reforçadas de segurança, autenticamos com 100% de certeza quem está realizando uma transação e os riscos de identidade atrelados. Desta forma, nossas soluções combatem fraudes, protegem dados e promovem a confiança entre pessoas, empresas e governos, colaborando para a construção de um mundo mais seguro e menos burocrático. Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo.

Você será analista de dados com experiência em combate a fraudes e paixão por transformar dados brutos em inteligência acionável. Estamos buscando uma pessoa para análise de dados e técnicas de machine learning para identificar, prevenir e mitigar fraudes de forma proativa. Você será a peça-chave na construção de um ecossistema de dados robusto, que nos permitirá estar sempre um passo à frente dos fraudadores.

Responsabilidades

  • Análise Estratégica de Dados: Analisar grandes volumes de dados de transações e comportamento de usuários para identificar padrões, anomalias e tendências de fraude que ainda não foram detectadas
  • Melhoria Contínua: Utilizar dados de fraudes passadas para otimizar nossas estratégias de prevenção, garantindo que nossos sistemas estejam preparados para combater ameaças futuras
  • Modelagem de Dados e ETL/ELT: Participar ativamente na melhoria e organização da nossa arquitetura de dados
  • Modelos de Prevenção: Colaborar com a equipe de ciência de dados na criação e no treinamento de modelos de detecção de fraude, incluindo modelos de IA e visão computacional, para aumentar a precisão e a velocidade das nossas respostas

O que precisamos que você conheça

  • Experiência em Análise de Fraude: Experiência comprovada em análise de dados com foco em detecção e prevenção de fraudes
  • Análise de Dados em Tempo Real: Habilidade para trabalhar com sistemas de monitoramento e análise de dados em tempo real
  • ETL/ELT: Conhecimento sólido em processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados
  • Métricas e Ferramentas: Experiência com métricas de produto e anti-fraude, e proficiência em ferramentas de análise de dados
  • Proficiência em Inglês: Fluência para se comunicar e trabalhar com equipes globais e documentações técnicas
  • Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta demanda e em esquema de plantão, quando necessário

Diferenciais

  • BigQuery: Experiência prática com Google BigQuery
  • Python: Proficiência na linguagem de programação Python, especialmente para manipulação de dados e scripts de automação

Benefícios

  • Benefício flexível: R$1.500,00 por mês que podem ser distribuídos nas modalidades VA/VR, Cultura, Mobilidade e Flex Férias
  • Auxílio home office: valor mensal de R$ 120,00 para pagamento de contas e consumo
  • PLR : elegível à Participação nos Lucros e Resultados conforme acordo sindicato
  • Benefício Educação: a Unico financia 100% dos estudos para 100% dos colaboradores através de cursos disponíveis na plataforma Unico Skill. Você pode escolher entre graduação, pós-graduação, MBAs, idiomas, cursos especializantes e mentorias
  • Bem-estar: acesso à plataformas como Gympass e Totalpass
  • Licença parental estendida: 180 dias para gestantes e cuidadores principais do processo de adoção e 60 dias para não gestantes e cuidados secundários do processo de adoção, com salário e benefícios pagos integralmente ao longo de todo o período

Local de trabalho

Adotamos o modelo de trabalho que prioriza o remoto, o nosso #tetounico. Isso significa que os Seres têm a opção de frequentar os escritórios caso queiram, e de acordo com as necessidades de cada área. Temos escritórios nas cidades de São Paulo e Londrina.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Na Unico estamos empenhados em construir uma cultura inclusiva, valorizando em todas as nossas posições a candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sua etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, política, religião, deficiência, naturalidade ou qualquer outro tipo de característica. Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, AI/ML & Analytics

4 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

Join to apply for the Engineering Lead role at TELUS Digital Brazil .

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role. You’ll also drive the team and our clients to use cutting-edge techniques and processes for software delivery, and use your technical prowess to shape the solutions we create. At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

  • Life insurance
  • Monthly voucher for meals, culture, education, health and mobility
  • Child care assistance and more!

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

When not responding to breaches, you will conduct enterprise threat hunting, help clients develop incident response plans, facilitate tabletop exercises as well as provide other strategic security services related to incident response.

The analyst will play a key role in evolving our grains analytics offering, currently focused on monthly forecasting and short‑term commentary, and expanding our capabilities in line with client demand for transparent, actionable insights across feed, food, and biofuel‑linked grain markets.

The ideal candidate is interested in economic and commodity market research and will thrive in a fast‑paced and innovative environment, have a can‑do attitude, juggle various tasks and projects, and meet deadlines.

Qualifications

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully. If you are open‑minded, curious, resilient, solutions‑oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

Knowledge, Experience and Skills

  • Understanding of global food and feed grain production regions and their trade interdependencies
  • Familiarity with how global energy policy impacts agricultural product supply and demand
  • Experience building or maintaining commodity supply/demand models, price models, and short‑term forecasting processes
  • Experience supporting commercial teams or engaging clients with insights and market outlook commentary
  • Able to critically assess statistical analyses and forecast models and suggest improvements and develop new models
  • Excellent written and verbal English

Behavioral Competencies

  • Manage deadlines across multiple forecasting cycles with strong time‑management and task‑prioritization skills
  • Willingness to learn new technological tools, new processes, or updated analytics workflows

  • Ensure commentary and forecasts are actionable and relevant to traders, processors, food companies, and biofuel participants
  • Build strong relationships with colleagues in analytics, editorial, sales, data engineering/science, and consulting

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.
The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.
Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies

Nice-to-have skills

  • Data Center infrastructure management and design
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Credit Risk Lead role at R2 .

At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America - where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank. R2 enables platforms in Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage (starting with revenue-based financing). We are a tight knit team coming from organizations such as Amazon, Google, Nubank, Capital One, Uber, Mercado Libre, Globant, J.P. Morgan and HSBC. We are backed by world-class investors such as Gradient Ventures (Google’s AI-focused fund), COMETA, General Catalyst, Hi Ventures, Y Combinator, Femsa Ventures, Prosus, Endeavor Catalyst, among others.

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Credit Risk Lead to drive decision-making processes and optimize credit portfolio performance. The ideal candidate will combine expertise in data analysis, machine learning, and statistical modeling to enhance risk assessment, develop actionable insights, and improve operational efficiency. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate cross-functionally and influence strategic decisions at the core of our credit risk infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Analysis
    • Analyze large, complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and correlations that influence credit risk and financial performance.
    • Provide actionable insights to key stakeholders to improve risk management strategies.
    • Provide actionable insights that can be reflected in Credit Policy
  • Machine Learning & AI
    • Develop and enhance predictive models using machine learning techniques to assess and mitigate credit risk.
    • Optimize algorithms to improve model performance and reduce risk exposure.
  • Portfolio Risk Assessment
    • Collaborate with the risk management team to evaluate the risk profile of the credit portfolio.
    • Forecast future risk trends and recommend data-driven mitigation strategies.
  • A/B Testing
    • Design and conduct A/B tests to evaluate the impact of new features on risk performance and adoption metrics.
  • Reporting & Visualization
    • Prepare comprehensive reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to executives, regulators, and other stakeholders.
  • Process Improvement
    • Identify opportunities to streamline operational processes and enhance decision-making frameworks.
  • Collaboration
    • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including credit risk, finance, and IT, to integrate models and data seamlessly into the organization’s risk infrastructure.

Requirements

  • Experience in developing and implementing machine learning models for risk assessment.
  • Programming languages such as Python, R, or similar.
  • Advanced SQL skills for querying and manipulating large datasets.
  • Strong statistical thinking and the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
  • Experience in designing and analyzing A/B tests to inform strategic decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting complex information to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment with a focus on innovation and results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with lending business and frameworks in credit risk management.
  • Knowledge of visualization tools

title: Coordenador(a) Facilities - Fábrica
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Objetivo do Cargo

Coordenar o time de analistas e os prestadores de serviços de Facilities da Fábrica, tais como, Portarias/acessos, Transporte dos colaboradores, Gestão de Frota, Segurança Patrimonial, Limpeza Convencional e Restaurante Industrial, definindo metas e indicadores, delegando responsabilidades, elaborando e aprovando planejamento e orçamento anual/mensal, garantindo a segurança das pessoas, otimizando recursos, custos e assegurando a eficiência dos serviços prestados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Implantação da Área de Facilities da Fábrica:
  • Coordenar os processos de Facilities: Portarias/acessos, Transporte dos colaboradores, Gestão de Frota, Segurança Patrimonial e Limpeza convencional, Jardinagem, e Restaurante Industrial, assegurando o correto dimensionamento e direcionamento dos recursos, avaliando os prestadores de serviço e realizando os ajustes necessários, garantindo a segurança do time e custos adequados;

Local:

Inocência - Mato Grosso do Sul – Brasil

Requisitos do Cargo:

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Facilities, Finanças, Logística ou Gestão de Projetos.
  • Experiência: Sólida vivência em posições de liderança em Facilities, preferencialmente em indústrias de base e projetos greenfield.

A proposta é preparar os participantes para assumir funções estratégicas, com envolvimento direto em desafios operacionais, projetos de inovação e processos ligados à produção de açúcar, etanol e energia.

O ‘Jovens Engenheiros’ é tratado pela companhia como uma das principais portas de entrada para talentos técnicos, com foco em desenvolvimento acelerado, vivência industrial e contato com um ambiente de alta exigência operacional.

description:
About

Phi Partners is a market leader for capital markets technology services, providing technology & quant services, solutions, and expertise to buy-side and sell-side financial institutions including some of the world’s largest investment banks, hedge funds and asset management firms. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in London, Phi has a presence in all major continents. Our niche focus on Front Office Technology has been a differentiator and gateway into the world’s best financial institutions.

Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialized in respective ‘Lines of Business’ (LoBs). Our latest São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence houses our Quant, Front Office & Risk Technology Services (FORTS) & Murex teams. The São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence was opened with the goal to strengthen Phi's current relationship with North America clients, as well as global clients with a presence in São Paulo. Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients.

About The FORTS Practice

Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing in FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front‑office and risk technology solutions, empowering top‑tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk‑management capabilities.

We specialize in the end‑to‑end implementation of front‑office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post‑go‑live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real‑time trading and risk management.

Additionally, we conduct extensive training and knowledge transfer sessions, ensuring client teams are equipped to maximize the value of their technology investments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop robust, scalable applications supporting E‑Trading systems across asset classes
  • Work with trading, operations, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver effective solutions
  • Apply sound design and architecture principles, using data structures and algorithms for performance
  • Stay current with technologies and industry trends, particularly within algorithmic and e‑Trading platforms
  • Analyze and resolve system bottlenecks, performance issues, and application bugs

Ideal Candidate

  • Hands‑on experience with C# – including experience in electronic trading platforms
  • Experience with unit testing and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge on one of the following: Equities; FX; Rates; Credit; and Derivatives is a plus
  • In‑depth knowledge of multithreading, memory management, and low‑latency systems
  • Solid understanding of design & architecture principles, common data structures and algorithms complexity
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, tools like IntelliJ, JIRA and Confluence, and version control in Git
  • Fluency in English (both written and spoken)

Why Join Phi Partners

Join us as we build the next‑generation eTrading team, an ambitious, fast‑growing group delivering world‑class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We’re in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading‑edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world‑leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

description:
Dam Safety Engineer/ Subject Matter Expert

Join to apply for the Dam Safety Engineer/ Subject Matter Expert role at HDR .

Overview

HDR is looking for Professional Engineers for various disciplines and in multiple locations across the country to join our Hydropower Practice. HDR is a hydropower and dam safety industry leader. We are experts in FERC Part 12 Dam Safety Program, and we perform FERC Comprehensive Assessments (CAs) and Periodic Inspections (PIs). HDR seeks Subject Matter Experts in Civil, Hydraulics/Hydrology, Structural, Geotechnical, Geological, and Mechanical engineering. Our national Hydropower Practice provides mechanical, electrical, structural, geotechnical and site civil engineering expertise, along with environmental scientists and regulatory specialists. Hydropower is a critical and renewable component of the US energy portfolio, and our team supports hydropower owners across the US and Canada. If you are looking for a dynamic work environment with career growth opportunities and the chance to work on innovative hydropower, pumped-storage and dam safety projects, we welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

Hybrid or flexible work locations are available across the country.

Primary duties

  • Support inspections and engineering assessments of existing dams and water-retaining structures.
  • Conduct analyses, evaluations and designs; develop design options or recommendations with supporting calculations.
  • Prepare contract documents including drawings, specifications, design documentation and criteria, and cost estimates for various new and/or rehabilitation of hydraulic structures, including dams, spillways, gates, outlet works, diversion structures, retaining walls, floodwalls, water conveyance structures, foundations, etc.
  • Perform engineering assignments that may require critical thinking and creativity to address unique elements with limited or no specific code-based guidance.
  • Work with multi-disciplinary teams on a variety of hydropower, pumped storage and dam safety engineering projects.
  • Work independently as project engineer and provide oversight, QA/QC and mentorship of staff as needed.
  • Participate in risk assessments for dams and hydraulic structures.
  • Some travel is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Geotechnical, Geological, or Geotechnical engineering (or related engineering degree).
  • Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in one of the following disciplines: Geotechnical, Geological, Civil/Structural or Hydrology and Hydraulics, or Mechanical engineering or life safety and economic consequence estimation.
  • Experience with dams, water conveyances or other constructed project works and infrastructure associated with hydropower and pumped-storage projects regulated by FERC or other agencies.
  • Experience working in a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, Excel and Word, AutoCAD and/or MicroStation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, able to work independently and with a project team to completion of task.
  • An attitude and commitment to quality, teaming, innovative problem solving, communication, relationship management, and the culture that is integral to our employee ownership model.
  • Ability to travel as needed for inspections, meetings or other requirements.
  • Experience specific to the hydropower industry, including one or more of:
    • Experience with the FERC dam safety regulatory process including preparation of DSSMPs, DSSMRs, STIDs, and participation in Part 12D dam safety inspections.
    • FERC dam safety assessment, analysis, and design experience.
    • Hydropower design experience relative to dams, penstocks, intakes, powerhouses, and/or retaining structures in and around hydropower facilities.
    • FERC SQRA facilitation training and experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • 7 years related experience.
  • A minimum 2 years project management experience.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • MS Office and MS Project experience is required (Access experience would be a plus).
  • Demonstrated leadership skills.
  • An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must.

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Eight groups, including Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, and Young Professionals, help create a sense of belonging. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

Overview

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the role: As a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager, you will serve as the crucial link between our prospective clients and internal teams. In this role, you will lead technical discovery sessions and consultative introduction calls, gather essential engagement details (such as timelines, budgets, skillset requirements, risks, and SWOT analyses), and translate these insights into impactful proposals. This position requires a strong grasp of both business strategy and the software development lifecycle (SDLC), along with outstanding communication and design skills to create engaging, high-quality deliverables.

What you will do

  • Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement: Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures; Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility; Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments; Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.
  • Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation: Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations; Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings; Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.
  • Team Buildout and Project Kickoff: Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand-offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick-off; Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding; Serve as a trusted advisor during pre-sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business-focused narratives; Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.

MUST HAVES

  • Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions.
  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
  • Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.
  • Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.
  • English: Upper Intermediate English level.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Ser o(a) estrategista e orquestrador(a) do programa de ABM 2026, criando narrativas, planos customizados, jornadas por conta e liderando iniciativas 1:1, 1:few e 1:many para gerar impacto real em contas estratégicas da base e new logo.

Estrategista de Conteúdo para cocriar narrativas, kits e peças personalizadas;

Construir e executar a estratégia de ABM alinhada aos direcionadores 2026.

Apoiar na priorização de contas (ICP, potencial, serviços contratados).

Criar planos ABM 1:1, 1:few e 1:many com hipóteses, jornadas e entregáveis.

Mapear stakeholders (C-level, diretoria, gerências) e suas dores/maturidade.

Cocriar narrativas personalizadas por conta, cluster e serviço.

Traduzir serviços da Qi em propostas de valor específicas por conta.

  • reuniões e experiências executivas (1:1)

Definir qual ação entra na jornada de cada conta.

Trabalhar em sinergia com DemGen e Eventos para execução.

Integrar narrativas com Estrategista de Conteúdo para personalização.

4) Governança do Programa ABM

Estabelecer e acompanhar KPIs ABM:

  • evolução de contas (frio → morno → quente)
  • engajamento
  • reuniões geradas
  • pipeline influenciado/criado
  • expansão de portfólio dentro da base

Gerir rituais semanais de alinhamento com Comercial, Google e Marketing.

Orquestrar o Painel Estratégico de Contas ABM, transformando dados em insights acionáveis que direcionem decisões executivas e movimentos de crescimento nas contas.

5) Relacionamento e Influência

Atuar como ponte entre Marketing, Comercial, Diretoria e Google.

Garantir consistência da narrativa de cada conta.

Coordenar personalizações com Conteúdo, Design e ABM Ops.

Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!

  • Employee Assistance Programme

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. title: Implementation Engineer
description:
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Implementation Engineer

Adyen is looking for an Implementation Engineer with a solid understanding of and hands‑on experience with technology, integration design, project management and a strong merchant focus. As an implementation consultant, you will be the primary point of contact for our merchant's technical teams, guiding them through the design, development, testing, and launch phases of their integrations with Adyen's platform. Your focus will be on ensuring an exceptional merchant experience throughout the project lifecycle.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on diverse projects that encompass various payment solutions, including e‑commerce platforms, marketplaces, and card issuing programs. By leveraging your technical proficiency and business acumen, you will play a vital role in guaranteeing a smooth implementation process and maintaining open lines of communication with our merchants and internal teams. This position is based in our Brazil office, and the ideal candidate is both consultative and technical.

What you’ll do:

  • Utilize development and programming expertise to create scalable and robust solutions for merchant integrations, while ensuring adherence to payment best practices.
  • Serve as a consultative partner in specific verticals such as e‑commerce, point of sale, and multi‑faceted platforms, guiding merchants through integration processes.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Account Managers, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver seamless merchant experiences and drive continuous improvements.
  • Leverage project management and technical consulting skills to oversee high‑quality project delivery, guaranteeing the technical integrity of merchant integrations.
  • Provide consultation on optimizing payment solutions, including checkout experiences, authentication, omni‑channel payments, and platform onboarding, while collaborating with Developers and Product Managers to enhance the platform.

Who you are:

  • C1 level proficiency in Portuguese and English is required for this position.
  • 5+ years of technical consultative experience, providing guidance and recommendations for clients integrating Web API solutions. Experience in payments is a plus.
  • Proven ability to quickly learn new technologies, understand complex systems (APIs, databases, SDK's, etc.), and desire to improve technical acumen.
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable leading discussion with different audiences, e.g. development team, non‑technical stakeholders and leadership.
  • Ability to understand how different systems work together within a larger software environment. This includes in-depth knowledge and debugging of REST or similar API protocols.

Check out what our implementation teams have to say about their roles here and here.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our São Paolo office. We are an office‑first company and value in‑person collaboration; we do not offer remote‑only roles.

title: Especialista em Meio Ambiente
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todos as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Realizar o desdobramento da estratégia de meio ambiente junto a unidade, elaborando o Plano Anual de Meio Ambiente, sendo responsável pelo envolvimento das áreas chave e monitoramento dos indicadores de resultado;
  • Atuar como consultor técnico na elaboração de estudos de impacto ambiental positivo, identificando e propondo soluções que visam a eliminação de desperdício, o aproveitamento racional dos recursos naturais, com foco em água, carbono e energia e resíduos;
  • Avaliar o atendimento das regulamentações ambientais pertinentes e outros requisitos subscritos, planejando as ações necessárias para assegurar a conformidade;
  • Contratar os serviços ambientais pertinentes, por meio da elaboração de escopos, identificação e homologação de prestadores de serviço e equalizações técnicas;
  • Elaborar os relatórios para comunicação do atendimento às regulamentações junto ao IAT, IBAMA e demais órgãos, além de representar a empresas em reuniões junto a estes, quando necessário;
  • Responsável pelo gerenciamento de resíduos sólidos da unidade, inventariando os resíduos gerados, planejando a movimentação e armazenamento interno, selecionando transportadores e destinatários, com foco na valorização do resíduo;
  • Receber as demandas das partes interessadas da unidade, apoia na avaliação da procedência, perdas e danos, estabelecimento e implementação das ações e devidas devolutivas;
  • Implementar e participar das rotinas de mudança cultural junto às lideranças e colaboradores da unidade;
  • Registrar, comunicar e facilitar a investigação de eventos ambientais;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento do inventário de GEE e a estratégia de descarbonização;
  • Implementar Projetos Ambientais conforme demanda / oportunidade;
  • Consolidar indicador de performance ambiental e conduz processo de análise crítica da unidade;

Requisitos:

  • Especialização em Meio Ambiente;
  • Experiência em gestão ambiental de Indústria;
  • Conhecimento dos requisitos legais aplicáveis de Meio Ambiente;
  • Conhecimento em sistema de gerenciamento de requisitos legais, SGA-IAT, SINIR, Ibama e correlatos;
  • Conhecimento do pacote Office com Excel avançado.
